title: MiCAR Register Observatory Feed v1
description: docs/feed.json: the current register totals and the last 200 change records. Fields marked as added are missing from feeds written up to the 2026-10-12 snapshot. Field meanings: docs/data-dictionary.md.

quarantine.description: Added with the 2026-10-19 snapshot. The export set aside after snapshot_date, or null.

entities.description: Added with the 2026-10-19 snapshot. Distinct LEIs, or names where a row has none.

source_last_modified.description: Added with the 2026-10-19 snapshot. The HTTP Last-Modified header of the export, verbatim; empty when the server sent none.

fetched_from.description: Added in November 2026. Where the export was downloaded from: ESMA's URL, or the Wayback Machine's copy of it when ESMA refused the download; empty for a snapshot recorded before November 2026.

archived_at.description: Added in November 2026. When the Wayback Machine captured the copy (its Memento-Datetime header, verbatim); empty for a download from ESMA.
